labels.defect: All-or-nothing merge gate wrongly fails when provider legs are legitimately absent: with only a subset of providers configured, the required check stays red and blocks merges that a configured provider already passed
labels.evidence: Fix #17: gate rewritten to count successful 'Self-review — <provider>' legs via the jobs API and pass on >=1, plus empty_reason outputs so the error message stops telling an already-labelled maintainer to apply the ready label.

adjudication.notes: C073-d1: PR #15 created the all-or-nothing gate; fix #17 rewrote it to count successful provider legs (pass on >=1) with empty_reason hints.
